other.general.name: General dissatisfaction
other.general.description: These reviews express broad dissatisfaction with Spotify or its updates without identifying a specific app problem.

examples.quote: The updates are getting worse.
The new updates are making spotify even more trash:(
I might as well just totally discontinue usage of this service.

playback.general.name: Music stops or plays incorrectly
playback.general.description: Music may stop unexpectedly, restart, report a false offline status, or fail to play the intended song.

examples.quote: it keep stopping!!
Getting msg since last update that I am offline when I am not.
The only problem is when I'll be listening to music and the song will just stop and the I check it out and it starts over the whole song

billing.paywall_named_feature.name: Features restricted to Premium
billing.paywall_named_feature.description: Specific listening and playback features, including lyrics and repeat, are unavailable or limited without Premium.

examples.quote: Even the basic features (like listening to specific parts in a song) are taken away.
woooow can't even put a playlist on repeat anymore
Very useless cant even repeat a song

usability.ads.name: Too many advertisements
usability.ads.description: People find the volume or repetition of advertisements disruptive, including during podcasts.

examples.quote: paying for premium and there's mad ads all throughout podcast.
It is a great app my only problem is ads that repeat each other
Everything is good except loads of advertisement.

usability.general.name: General usability complaints
usability.general.description: These reviews describe broad annoyances with the app, including advertising, without a consistent specific usability issue.

examples.quote: Fix blend, doesn't work with links given and all it does is reroute to the app without opening blend.
It's a good app but I get the same odd 'ah-flack' add all the time to the point it's so annoying that I sorta wanna delete/uninstall the app
Extra ordinary app but one problem is add

billing.premium_other.name: Pressure to get Premium
billing.premium_other.description: People feel pushed toward Premium because ads and limits make the free experience difficult to use.

examples.quote: Spotify is forcing us to get premium.
Premium for everything!!!
Full of Ads ...can't do anything without buying premium membership

usability.playback_controls.name: Playback controls behave unexpectedly
usability.playback_controls.description: People report missing or unreliable playback controls, including previous track, shuffle, and Smart Shuffle options.

examples.quote: Not able to select previous song.
Because it literally doesn't work, it's the same order every time and sometimes just the default order of the Playlist.
Please give me the option to turn OFF Smart Shuffle.

limitations_given: Reviews are self-selected, public and historical (an eighteen-month window of Google Play reviews ending in November); they are not a representative sample of all Spotify users.
There is no revenue, plan tier, or confirmed churn data; stated cancellation intent is not observed churn, and no revenue impact can be inferred.
Labels come from a model; agreement with human labels and with an independent verifier is reported separately and is imperfect.
Issue groups come from fixed code rules on matched feature words, so a broad catch-all group can hide several distinct problems.
Reviews that were quarantined or left unclassified are excluded from the ranking.
